deadline.value: Funding deadline: Physics Jan 22, 2027 (Astronomy/Astrophysics Jan 4, 2027). Admission without funding accepted until the end of June.
deadline.quote: Applicants for Research Council or University PhD funding are required to submit their applications by the following deadlines: Astronomy / Astrophysics: Monday 4th January 2027 Physics: Friday 22nd January 2027

supervisor.value: No need to contact supervisors before applying unless you propose your own project; name preferred supervisors on the form
supervisor.quote: There is no requirement to make contact before applying, but you should do so if you are proposing your own project.

funding.value: School studentships include full tuition; UKRI limits how many international students can be funded, but other routes exist
funding.quote: All studentships administered by the School will include a 100% tuition fee contribution.

entry_route.value: Most current PhD students had no master's before starting
entry_route.quote: Most of our current PhD students did not have a Masters degree before starting their programme.

english_waiver.value: An English-taught degree counts only if your institution is on the University's approved list for non-majority-English-speaking countries
english_waiver.quote: My institution is not on the University's approved list of universities in non-majority English-speaking countries (MESC), but my degree was taught in English. Can this still be accepted as proof of meeting the English language requirements? The University rigorously scrutinises all institutions that teach and assess in English

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with at least 6.0 in each component.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS Academic: total 6.5 with at least 6.0 in each component.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT for tests from 21 January 2026: 4.5 total with at least 4.5 in each component (old scale: 92 with 23 in each).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL-iBT (including Home Edition) from 21 January 2026: total 4.5 with at least 4.5 in each component.

notes: Apply early if you need funding or a visa.
